name: Replit
verdict: An all-in-one cloud IDE plus agent; Core is $20 a month, or $18 if you pay annually.
pros: Hosting and the agent are in the same place
cons: Paid agent work is effort-priced and can add up
Core credits do not roll over
pricingNote: Core and Pro prices are the cards on replit.com/pricing. The free Starter plan is described on docs.replit.com/help/pricing-and-plans; that page does not print a dollar amount for it.
